name: Imposter Killer
summary: Deep in space, a crew is working together to keep their spaceship running. But one of them is not who they seem! In Imposter Killer, you must eliminate your crewmates without raising suspicion. Sneak, sabotage, and strike at the perfect moment to take control of the ship. But beware—others are watching, and if they catch you, it's game over! Can you be the last one standing?
